Simulate temporally correlated fish-detection misses as conditional sensitivity scenarios

aqt_detection_dropout_scenarios.Rd

Constructs a fish-scoped, two-state Markov missingness process on genuine observed rows while preserving all original source timestamps, existing missing observations and track identifiers. Parameters are user-assumed sensitivity inputs; this does not calibrate observation probabilities or confidence interval coverage.

Usage

aqt_detection_dropout_scenarios(tracks, p_missing, persistence = 0.5, draws = 100L, seed = 42L)

Arguments

tracks

Original validated aqt_tracks in 2D or 3D.

p_missing

Assumed stationary probability of missing an originally observed fish row, between zero and one.

persistence

Within-fish temporal correlation parameter in [0,1).

draws

Positive integer sensitivity draws (at most 1000).

seed

Reproducible integer RNG seed. The original RNG state is restored.

Value

An aqt_detection_dropout_scenarios object with tracks (complete original time-scope rows, additional missing positions set to NA), coverage, and assumptions.

Details

Transitions are defined by stationary missingness p and persistence rho: P(drop_next | drop_previous) = p + rho * (1-p); P(drop_next | observed_previous) = p * (1-rho). Simulated fish frames are not new independent replicates. No original fish detection, camera calibration or physical 3D accuracy is certified.
